sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows 2376 ppm defects (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We are happy to go with the 1500 ppm target from your third package to improve our quality standing. Our price for this is €46.50, but to support this we really need to look at faster payment terms. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.50 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
